name: Drywall hang and finish
summary: Drywall hang-and-finish priced per net square foot by board, finish level and ceiling height.

items.label: Hang and finish 1/2 in board, level 4, 9-ft great room
items.source: (hang 1.15 + level-4 finish 3.6 h/100 sf) x 1.10 waste x 1.15 height multiplier for >8 ft (BOARD_PRESETS half-4x8, FINISH_LEVELS, heightMultiplier); board $48 + mud $30 per 100 billable sf x 1.10 + 0.42 tape lf/sf x $0.09 (TAPE_MATERIAL_PER_LF); 20x16x9 room with ceiling (index.html STARTING_ROOMS) less its share of 86 sf openings

items.label: Hang and finish 1/2 in board, level 4, 8-ft rooms
items.source: same rates at height multiplier 1.0; 12x12x8 bedroom + 8x6x8 bath with ceilings (index.html STARTING_ROOMS) less their share of 86 sf openings

items.label: Openings (doors and windows)
items.source: HOURS_PER_OPENING 0.28; 18 tape lf per opening x $0.09 (TAPE_LF_PER_OPENING, TAPE_MATERIAL_PER_LF); 7 openings (index.html openingCount)

items.label: Tear out existing drywall
items.source: 1.6 h per 100 sf (TEAR_OFF_HOURS_PER_100, index.html); no per-sf material in the specialist (dumpster below); tear-out unchecked by default

items.label: Stilts or scaffold
items.source: ADD_ON_PRESETS stilts 2.5 h, $120; unchecked by default

items.label: Extra corner bead
items.source: ADD_ON_PRESETS cornerBead 2 h, $85; unchecked by default

specialistModels: Room-by-room wall and ceiling takeoff with sheet counts, board types, finish levels 0-5, texture, and per-room height multipliers.
